A '''mobil-haus''' was a type of spacious shelter that could both comfortably house a large number of individuals and be quickly packed up and moved.<ref name="Databank" /> A mobil-haus consisted of four pop out bedroom units on wheels connected to a central hub. The central hub included space for a common area and kitchen. A fifth fixed protrusion from the central hub include a cockpit and communication setup. The shelters were utilized to on the agricultural farm world [[Mina-Rau]]<ref name="One Year Later" /> by [[Technician|mechanics]].<ref name="Databank" /> 

In [[4 BBY]], [[Bix Caleen]], [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], [[B2EMO]], [[Wilmon Paak]], [[Brasso]], and [[Talia (Mina-Rau)|Talia]] shared a mobil-haus while they lived and worked on Mina-Rau.<ref name="One Year Later" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
A mobil-haus appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' which was released on [[April 22]], [[2025]].<ref name="One Year Later" /> An entry identifying the shelter was added to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] site on the same day.<ref name="Databank" /> It was built as a full interior and exterior set for the show.<ref name="Week1Trivia">{{SW|url=news/andor-trivia-guide-week-1|text=Secrets from the Set of ''Andor'' Season 2: Week 1 Trivia}}</ref>
